$Comment: A day contract on Old Jack's board: its Difficulty band Hallows_Eve_Day posts it in the board's daylight slots, since it can be finished before dark. USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Crack counts a Cursed Geode cracked open. It writes its own Rewards.Auto, the base's list with MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row added (Mining XP, the skill the geodes turn up with), because a child's list replaces the base's whole. A server without that mod skips the row.
